heroText: We create worlds to explore, stories to share and adventures with you as the main character.
ribbon: Your choices. Your encounters. Your stories.
heritageText: A castle to discover. A character to develop. Encounters that could change everything. Our Minecraft roleplay project invites you to write your own chapter in the wizarding world.
heritageNote: Visit the dedicated website to discover the project, its latest news and details on how to take part.
worldsText: Mythology, the supernatural, heroes and survival: five more worlds are in preparation. Find the one that speaks to you and follow its first stories with us.
percyText: Gods, monsters and a legacy to embrace. A new roleplay adventure in the world of Percy Jackson is being prepared.
teenText: When night falls, certainty fades. A world where bonds, secrets and instinct shape your story.
nationsText: Water, earth, fire and air. Choose your path in a world where balance is built together.
avengersLine: What happens next is up to you.
avengersText: Beyond the powers lie the choices. A roleplay project filled with encounters and adventures on a heroic scale.
lastLine: There is still a story to live.
lastText: In a world that has changed, every encounter matters. An adventure where survival also begins with trust.
studioText: Immersive Studio brings roleplay projects together around one belief: the best stories are the ones we live together. We imagine the worlds. You bring your choices, your emotions and your way of playing.
craftText: An identity, an atmosphere and details that make you want to explore further. Each project develops a character of its own.
storiesText: Roleplay begins with you: a character, motivations and encounters. The adventure takes shape as you play.
peopleText: Go behind the scenes, talk about the projects and share the anticipation of adventures to come: it all starts on our Discord.
faqTitle: Want to hear what comes next?
faq1Q: Where can I follow project progress?
faq1A: The Immersive Studio Discord is the meeting place for announcements and conversations about our worlds. L’Héritage de Poudlard also has its own website.
faq2A: L’Héritage de Poudlard is in development. The five other worlds are in preparation. Dates and access requirements will be shared through each project’s official channels.
faq3A: You can already learn about the worlds and join the community. Rules and participation details will be provided for each project.
faq4Q: How can I contact the studio?
faq4A: Join our Discord to talk with the community and contact the team about the projects.
communityLabel: There is already a place for you in the story
communityText: Go behind the scenes at Immersive Studio. Discover the projects, share your ideas and meet the people who will write what comes next with you.
footerTag:
We create the worlds.
You bring them to life.
footerBottom: Imagination is made to be shared.
fanNote: Independent community projects with no official affiliation to the rights holders of the worlds presented.
metadataTitle: Immersive Studio — Imagination. On a grand scale.
metadataDescription: Discover L’Héritage de Poudlard and the roleplay worlds in preparation at Immersive Studio. Worlds to experience, together.
